trans-unit.source: Look! If I go in with a disguise, no one'll ever know.
trans-unit.target: Look! If I go in with a disguise, no one'll ever know.

trans-unit.source: Then how about I just blow all the guards away with a spell?
trans-unit.target: Then how about I just blow all the guards away with a spell?

trans-unit.source: What's the problem!? I only went into the Ymir Forest for a little bit!
trans-unit.target: What's the problem!? I only went into the Ymir Forest for a little bit!

trans-unit.source: They gave you a *death sentence*! Or have you forgotten?
trans-unit.target: They gave you a *death sentence*! Or have you forgotten?

trans-unit.source: Good lord, she never learns anything.
trans-unit.target: Good lord, she never learns anything.
